description: Structure of the install_plugin task payload.

id.description: The unique id of this task.

slug.description: The slug of the wordpress plugin to install or an https url to download the plugin from.

url.description: The url to download the plugin from. If not given the url will be generated from the slug to point to wordpress.org.

force.description: If true, the plugin will uninstall a potentially existing instance of this plugin
